meta.task: Task 4: QAOA circuits, offline tuning and benchmarks (statevector only; no backend run)
meta.note: all tuning is offline on a classical statevector and uses the training-derived objective only; no test-period data, no quantum hardware, no speed-up claim
meta.scale_policy: scale = max(max|J_ij|, max|h_i|) of the model (one scale for couplings and fields); 1.0 if below 1e-12
meta.sign_note: mixer is rx(+2 beta): lowering the energy needs gamma and beta of opposite sign; the ramp 0.6 / 0.3 as written (same sign) is kept as a measured control

tuning.selection_rule: lowest expected model energy (the tuning objective); never P(optimum), never test data
